title: Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability
abstract: arXiv:2611.19982v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. translated_title: 面向IT运维可观测性的自主多模态智能体
translated_abstract: IT运维可观测性产品必须整合来自不同工具和系统的数据。我们提出了ITOps Observability Studio，这是一个多模态多智能体系统，通过协作式AI智能体来编排可观测性工作流。其三层架构的特点包括智能体间通信、用于数据访问、模式操作和可视化的专用LLM驱动智能体，以及统一的工具集成。该系统支持自然语言到GraphQL的翻译、GraphQL模式生成、模式映射、追踪数据生命周期管理以及面向可靠性工程的多工具工作流。其智能体配备了智能体分析功能，因此可以追踪它们的模型调用和工具调用。我们在各自的基准测试上评估每个智能体，在存在标准答案的地方对照标准答案评分，对于模式映射和图表质量则由模型评判。在公共基准上的查询生成和路由在当前开源模型上表现良好，数据（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了ITOps Observability Studio，一个采用三层架构的多模态多智能体系统，通过协作式LLM驱动智能体编排IT运维可观测性工作流，支持自然语言到GraphQL的转换、模式生成与映射、追踪数据生命周期管理及面向可靠性工程的多工具工作流。
en_tdlr: The paper presents ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system with a three-tier architecture that orchestrates ITOps observability workflows through collaborative LLM-powered agents, supporting natural language to GraphQL translation, schema generation and mapping, trace data lifecycle management, and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering.
